dateAssessment: No calendar date is spoken. As a working calendar only, YAML October 3–5, DR 1740 fits the opening camp, the next day’s hike and manor arrival, and the following morning’s long-rest completion. The earlier few days of westward travel remain undated and are not forced into that two-boundary span; the extraction’s whole-interval assessment is compatible, not matched. The party has not yet emerged from the root crossing. The moving sun, sunset, and clock readings in this session are Material Plane evidence; no Feywild day or watch is inferred from lighting. Hulda’s dragon story is background: the transcript says last winter, while his vault biography says spring 1740.

watches.day: Before the opening camp; departure undated
watches.summary: A few days of westward travel precede the camp; departure date and watches remain open.
Campfire dinner for the night, in deep fall; calendar date is conditional on YAML.
Watches pass uneventfully overnight; morning camp departure establishes one date transition.
During the morning hike, used paths become trackless woodland.
Around noon, Alden urges eating while walking to reach the house before dark.
By afternoon the forest’s visible wildlife and sounds have diminished.
A long day’s hike ends before dark; final sunlight disappears during Hulda’s introductions.
The grandfather clock chimes ten during the party’s evening discussion.
Eight-hour long rest ends before dawn, loosely around six; the clock is approximate.
